summary.text: Jeff Tenczar is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 1 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former New Hampshire state trooper and teacher, he lives in Pelham.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Tenczar lives in Pelham, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University and a master's degree from Suffolk University.
His career experience includes working as a New Hampshire state trooper and as a teacher with Lowell Public Schools.
In the 2023-2024 session, Tenczar was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
